reuse.why: Fintegra reuses bank lookup and account-link orchestration, shares the Akahu downloader, and replacement shares local unlink cleanup with the existing unlink action.

duplication.why: Holder lookup, linking restrictions, unlink cleanup, and the new provider's transaction download are shared rather than copied.

placement.why: Link policy remains in account orchestration, transaction transport remains in sync.ts, and provider configuration and models follow existing boundaries.

scope.why: The changes support the four requested steps, apart from an unrelated import reorder in schedules/app.ts.

maintainability.why: The helpers have clear responsibilities, although every provider adapter must remember to invoke validation before creating its bank entry.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six provider link handlers use the shared validation and linking functions, and replacement uses cleanup shared with unlinkAccount.

disguised_duplication.where: The extracted cleanup and parameterized downloader consolidate existing logic without introducing reshaped copies.

abstraction_drift.where: linkBankSyncAccount gains replaceExistingLink, the extracted downloader gains serverUrl and providerName, and replacement introduces conditional cleanup and a validation exemption; these express requested variation without provider-specific helper branches.
